name: Nightly 0.3.0-nightly.6
body:
## What's Changed
* docs: record that the release controller numbers past the update feed by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/826
* fix(web): keep focus in place when hiding a side or the bottom panel by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/827
* test(server): persist terminal recordings only after a printed marker arrives by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/828
* fix(shared): re-check the Central artifact once a moved watch is live by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/830
* test: give the Windows path gate a 30 s per-test budget by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/832
* test(server): give the stubborn stdio MCP termination test a budget above its own wait by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/833
* fix(web): focus a retried terminal only after its failed frame stops being inert by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/837
* test(e2e): prove terminal output isolation with markers only command output can print by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/838
* test(e2e): force the recall-then-replace interleaving instead of sampling it under CPU throttling by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/839
* test(e2e): branch the Welcome provider warning check on the host's provider state by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/841
* test(e2e): let the chat's placement motion settle before clicking a sticky breadcrumb target by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/842
* test(e2e): click Latest and interrupt its return in one task from the current position by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/843
* fix(web): correct the reading anchor after a fold change only once Virtuoso has measured it by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/844
* fix(web): keep Virtuoso's own scroll corrections out of reader intent by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/845
* fix(resource-renderers): reuse a finished diff when React restarts the Show-anyway render by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/846
* fix(resource-renderers): keep the preview's state object when a re-read changes nothing by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/847
* test: warm PowerShell once before the timed install.ps1 tests by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/849
* test(server): keep each chat-resources test's commands and publisher inside that test by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/850
* feat(scripts): add an on-demand CI flake report by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/851
* ci: run artifact suites on PRs only for artifact changes; drop Windows caches; bound jobs by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/825
* test(server): close an idle terminal only after its shell finished starting by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/829
* test(e2e): reach Monaco through an actionability-checked hover before wheel scrolling by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/848
* fix(subagents): support strict thinking suffixes in model references by @SBOne-Kenobi in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/831
* perf(web): preload ChatView on workbench mount so a restored chat skips the Suspense reveal delay by @Mark-Life in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/789
* chore: bump Bun to 1.4.4 to drop the compromised emSign roots by @Mark-Life in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/810
* build(ts): turn on unused, implicit-return and fallthrough tsc checks by @Mark-Life in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/790
* perf(web): let the React Compiler optimize components that used try/finally by @Mark-Life in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/800
* fix(web): keep long chat message content inside user bubble by @suryakant-source in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/792
* feat(web): show subagent model and effort in Resources by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/855
* perf(resource-renderers): mount Monaco directly without @monaco-editor/react by @Mark-Life in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/816
* perf(shared): probe the login-shell env without blocking desktop boot by @Mark-Life in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/791
* test(e2e): stop the ask_user_question and theme.spec flakes by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/862
* fix(server): omit deleted project folders from Recent Projects by @suryakant-source in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/795
* fix(web): close history search overlay on toggle and outside click by @suryakant-source in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/796
* fix(server): reject template names containing a colon by @suryakant-source in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/797

## New Contributors
* @suryakant-source made their first contribution in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/792

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/compare/v0.3.0-nightly.5...v0.3.0-nightly.6

name: Nightly 0.3.0-nightly.4
body:
## What's Changed
* feat(web): merge Changes into a VS Code-like Files panel by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/779
* fix: use one spelling for Windows directory and relative paths by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/775
* feat: always show Remote and Pull request in the topbar with the branch's next step by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/771
* feat: GitHub review details and actions in the topbar by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/776
* Minor performance improvements by @zhuravlikjb in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/798
* feat(web): translate the interface and let users add their own languages by @rsolmano in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/788
* fix(desktop): make Windows updates install and show the install journey across the restart by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/803
* feat: unconditional PII-free PostHog error tracking with readable stacks by @rsolmano in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/769
* Blog: Updates to blog posts with info about our social media by @makingthematrix in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/809
* ci: add a single CI passed gate and skip heavy jobs for site-only changes by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/818
* ci: drop the legacy required-check mirror jobs by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/819
* ci: install Chromium without apt deps and cache desktop apt packages from main by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/820
* fix: stabilize the tests that fail CI across unrelated branches by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/821
* ci: classify a merge group against its target branch, not the entry ahead by @danyaberezun in https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/pull/824


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail/compare/v0.3.0-nightly.3...v0.3.0-nightly.4
